claims.claim: Every A9 packing can be normalized into an 1188×839 subrectangle with all sheet coordinates in the semigroup ⟨37,52⟩.
claims.evidence: For fixed labels and orientations, the feasible configuration space is compact. At a minimizer of the sum of all left and top coordinates, any sheet with positive x-coordinate must have a positive-vertical-overlap blocker whose right edge equals its left edge; otherwise a sufficiently small left shift reduces the objective. Iterating blockers strictly decreases x and terminates at x=0, expressing every horizontal endpoint as a nonnegative sum of 37 and 52. The identical argument applies vertically. Exact enumeration shows the largest representable endpoints within 1189 and 841 are 1188 and 839; 1189, 840, and 841 are unrepresentable.
claims.witness: Blocker chains give x=Σw_i and y=Σh_i with every summand in {37,52}; the checker confirms max(⟨37,52⟩∩[0,1189])=1188 and max(⟨37,52⟩∩[0,841])=839.
claims.search_method: Direct compactness and blocker-chain proof, followed by exhaustive semigroup enumeration; no external search.

claims.claim: There is an explicit packing of 516 sheets.
claims.evidence: The three coordinate families contain 60, 8, and 448 rectangles. Their extents are respectively [0,1040]×[0,111], [1040,1188]×[0,104], and [0,1184]×[111,839], so distinct families meet only at boundaries and each internal grid is disjoint. All 516 rectangles have dimensions 52×37 or 37×52 and lie within 1188×839.
claims.witness: The checker generated all 516 rectangles and tested dimensions, containment, and all 132,870 pairwise separation conditions.
claims.search_method: Direct coordinate expansion and exhaustive pairwise exact-geometry verification.

claims.evidence: Every integer-aligned 52×37 rectangle contains one marked cell in each of its 37 rows, and every 37×52 rectangle contains one in each of its 37 columns, for exactly 37 cells satisfying x+y≡50 mod 52. The normalized 1188×839 container has exactly 19,162 such cells, while 518 sheets would require 518·37=19,166.
claims.witness: Exact totals are 19,162=517·37+33<518·37; all 52² placement phases in both orientations were checked.
claims.search_method: Exhaustive modular-cell count over the container and all placement phases.

claims.claim: A normalized 517-packing could have only one of four bounding dimensions: 1186×839, 1187×839, 1188×838, or 1188×839.
claims.evidence: The sheets have total area 517·52·37=994,708. Exhausting every representable W≤1188 and H≤839 with WH≥994,708 leaves exactly the four stated pairs. In particular, 1185·839 and 1188·837 are too small, while 1186·838 and 1187·838 are also below the required area.
claims.witness: Complete semigroup-product enumeration returned [(1186,839),(1187,839),(1188,838),(1188,839)] and no other pair.
claims.search_method: Exhaustive exact enumeration of both semigroup-coordinate dimensions.

claims.claim: The near-extremal side decompositions, and hence their normalization blocker chains, are rigid.
claims.evidence: Each relevant dimension has exactly one nonnegative representation: 1186=10·52+18·37, 1187=15·52+11·37, 1188=20·52+4·37, 838=9·52+10·37, and 839=14·52+3·37. A blocker chain ending at a sheet attaining the bounding endpoint sums exactly to that endpoint, so its counts of 52- and 37-length links are forced. This verifies rigidity in the count sense asserted by the proof sketch, not a unique ordering of links.
claims.witness: Exhaustive Diophantine enumeration found one coefficient pair for each of the five dimensions.
claims.search_method: Enumeration of all nonnegative solutions to 52i+37j=s for each side s.

claims.claim: Every candidate 517-box has exact nonnegative line-defect identities summarized by four pairs of orientation equations.
claims.evidence: From 37a_x+52b_x+g_x=37A+52C, the displayed parametrization follows by substitution and congruence; q_x<0 would imply a_x≥A+52>⌊H/37⌋. The draft writes a strict sign before A+52, but the correct weak sign suffices. The row argument similarly gives p_y≥0 because p_y<0 would make c_y≤B−37<0. Summation reproduces exactly (U,column constant,row constant)=(346,115,180),(1185,228,180),(836,341,340),(2024,341,180).
claims.witness: Every arithmetically feasible column and row pattern in all four boxes was enumerated; all q and p values were integral, nonnegative, and satisfied both equations.
claims.search_method: Algebraic derivation plus exhaustive finite enumeration of feasible line-count patterns.

claims.claim: Residue-class incidence gives exact lower bounds on the carry totals Q and P.
claims.evidence: A width-52 sheet meets exactly one unit column in every class modulo 52, while a width-37 sheet does so modulo 37; the analogous height-52 fact holds for rows. Summing the defect equations within each class eliminates the gap sum modulo 7 or 5. Because every class carry is a nonnegative integer, its least congruent residue is a valid exact-arithmetic lower bound, and summing over the partition bounds Q or P.
claims.witness: The checker independently solved each class congruence and summed its least nonnegative residue for every relevant orientation count.
claims.search_method: Direct incidence counting and exact modular enumeration.

claims.evidence: Its exact aggregate identities are n=115−Q and n=180+P. Since Q,P≥0, they require n≤115 and n≥180 simultaneously.
claims.witness: The candidate has unused area 346 and defect constants 115 and 180; no integer n,Q,P satisfies both equations with Q,P≥0.
claims.search_method: Direct contradiction from independently recomputed aggregate identities.

claims.evidence: The aggregate equations restrict n to 340 with Q=1 or n to 341 with Q=0. For n=340, the 44 size-23 and 8 size-22 modulo-52 classes require Q≥44·3+8·2=148. For n=341 they require Q≥44·5+8·4=252. Both contradict the aggregate value of Q.
claims.witness: Exact residue enumeration returned lower bounds 148 and 252 for the only two possible orientation counts.
claims.search_method: Exhaustion of the aggregate possibilities followed by modulo-52 incidence bounds.

claims.evidence: Here Q=228−n≤48. The 43 size-23 modulo-52 classes force their least carry residue to be 0 or 1. Residue 0 makes the nine size-22 classes contribute at least 54, while residue 1 forces n=185 and Q=43. Then m=332, but the 34 size-32 modulo-37 classes alone force Q≥68. Thus every case is contradictory.
claims.witness: The checker reproduced Q≥43 for n=185 from modulo 52 and Q≥68 from modulo 37; exhaustive testing found no surviving n.
claims.search_method: Exact congruence case split, independently supplemented by exhaustive orientation-count enumeration.

claims.claim: The full 1188×839 candidate box is impossible.
claims.evidence: The aggregate equations give Q+P=161. Independently solving the column and row class congruences for r=n mod 7 yields (C_r,R_r)=(96,149),(200,45),(304,305),(44,201),(148,97),(252,42),(48,253). Their sums are 245,245,609,245,245,294,301, each strictly exceeding 161.
claims.witness: All seven residue pairs and their contradiction with Q+P=161 were reproduced exactly.
claims.search_method: Complete seven-residue enumeration using the independently derived incidence equations.

claims.claim: The exact orthogonal packing number of A9 sheets in A0 is 516.
claims.evidence: The explicit coordinates prove OPT≥516. Any packing with at least 517 sheets contains a 517-sheet subpacking; normalization places it in one of the four exhaustively listed bounding boxes, and claims 7–10 exclude every box. Hence OPT≤516 and equality follows for the source's real-coordinate orthogonal model.
claims.witness: A verified 516 placement and a complete architecture-independent exclusion of every normalized 517-packing.
claims.search_method: Combined lower construction, normalization, exhaustive bounding-box reduction, and exact incidence contradictions.

claims.claim: The natural horizontal 111+728 decomposition is exactly capped at 516.
claims.evidence: Area caps the 1188×111 part at 68, attained by the first two displayed grids. In the 1188×728 part, exhaustive local line patterns verify 5a+7b≤98 vertically and 7c+5d≤160 horizontally. Integrating gives 259N+n≤116,424 and 260N−n≤116,480, hence 519N≤232,904<519·449 and N≤448. The third grid attains 448, so the split optimum is 68+448=516.
claims.witness: The checker exhaustively established both local pattern maxima and the combined right-hand side 232,904.
claims.search_method: Area calculation, finite line-pattern enumeration, and exact incidence integration.

claims.claim: The maximum size of a guillotine (slicing) A9-in-A0 packing is 516.
claims.evidence: Bottom-up compaction of a slicing tree replaces a vertical node by dimensions (w₁+w₂,max(h₁,h₂)) and a horizontal node by (max(w₁,w₂),h₁+h₂), never enlarging its allocated region. Starting from 37×52 leaves, every compacted dimension lies in ⟨37,52⟩, so the root is at most 1188×839. A dynamic program containing leaf, monotone-slack, every exact representable-width split, and every exact representable-height split is complete by induction on the slicing tree and evaluates to 516. The displayed construction is slicing, giving the matching lower bound.
claims.witness: The integer DP evaluated 395 positive representable widths and 203 positive heights—396 and 204 when zero is included—and returned G(1188,839)=516.
claims.search_method: Independent structural-induction reconstruction and exhaustive exact dynamic programming.

target_evidence: The draft supplies a checkable 516-sheet placement and a complete upper bound. Compactness and blocker chains reduce every real-coordinate packing to integral semigroup coordinates inside 1188×839. A hypothetical 517-subpacking then has exactly four possible bounding boxes. Exact nonnegative line-defect identities immediately exclude one box, and residue-class incidence excludes the other three, including all seven orientation residues in the full box. Therefore no packing of 517 or more exists and the exact source target is 516.
